% Shared Tikz Preamble for Diagram Atomization Pipeline
% Load this in every tikz generated by Phase 5 subagents.
% Do NOT redefine these — use exactly this preamble.

\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}

% Core libraries
\usetikzlibrary{
    arrows.meta,       % arrow styles
    positioning,       % relative placement
    cd,                % commutative diagrams (tikz-cd)
    calc,              % coordinate calculations
    shapes.geometric,  % ellipses, polygons, etc.
    shapes.misc,       % rounded rectangles, etc.
    decorations.markings,  % arrow on paths
    backgrounds,       % background layer
    fit,               % fitting nodes around others
}

% Standard arrow tip
\tikzset{>=Stealth}

% Commutative diagram style
\tikzcdset{
    arrows={>=Stealth},
    row sep/normal=3em,
    column sep/normal=4em,
}

% Common node styles
\tikzset{
    mathnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, inner sep=2pt},
    labelnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, font=\small, inner sep=1pt},
}

\begin{document}
% Commutative square: extension of morphisms to closures
% Context: Grothendieck's algebraic de Rham cohomology,
% resolution of singularities, compactification strategy.
%
% Nodes:
%   TL: X'  — pre-image of X under resolution map
%   TR: \overline{X'}  — smooth proper resolution of \overline{X}
%   BL: X  — original smooth variety
%   BR: \overline{X}  — compactification/closure of X
%
% Arrows:
%   Top horizontal: X' \hookrightarrow \overline{X'} (inclusion)
%   Bottom horizontal: X \hookrightarrow \overline{X} (inclusion)
%   Left vertical: X' \to X (isomorphism, per extraction context)
%   Right vertical: \overline{X'} \to \overline{X} (resolution map)
%
% The square commutes.

\begin{tikzcd}
X' \arrow[r, hook] \arrow[d, "\cong"'] & \overline{X'} \arrow[d] \\
X \arrow[r, hook] & \overline{X}
\end{tikzcd}
\end{document}
